headlines.title: Meta agrees to pay $18 billion to settle social media addiction lawsuit
headlines.description: Meta has agreed to settle the social media addiction trial brought forward by California and other states for nearly $18 billion. NBC News' Allie Canal and Misty Marris have details on the settlement and what it means for the social media giant.

headlines.title: Dolly Parton Died After ‘Brief Battle With Cancer,’ Her Team Says
headlines.description: Legendary singer, songwriter, businesswoman and philanthropist Dolly Parton died at 80 surrounded by loved ones in a Nashville hospital. Her team confirming, “After bravely facing a brief battle with cancer, Dolly departed her earthly life.” Tributes are pouring in from throughout the entertainment world including from her “Steel Magnolias” co-star Sally Field and fellow music legend Paul McCartney. NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Mudslides and flash flooding cause devastation in Nepal and China's Tibet
headlines.description: A wall of mud and rock appeared to collapse ​into a river on the Himalayan border of Nepal and China’s Tibet, triggering catastrophic flooding on the Nepali side that killed at least 31 people and left ‌hundreds of tourists missing, including Americans.

headlines.description: NFL Kickoff Guide, powered by NBC Sports breaks down the most important stats, storylines and changes to know for all 32 teams heading into the 2026 season.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial in Massachusetts: Day 21
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three young children, continues in Massachusetts after the defense rested its case.

headlines.title: Darline Graham Wins South Carolina GOP Senate Primary Runoff
headlines.description: Trump-backed Darline Graham beat Ralph Norman to win the Republican senate nomination as she looks to secure a full six-year term to replace her late brother Lindsey Graham. Meanwhile, there was a new development in the Alaska senate race that could have implications for the general election in November. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump-backed Mike Mazzei wins the GOP nomination in the Oklahoma governor’s race
headlines.description: Former state Sen. Mike Mazzei has secured the Republican nomination for governor in Oklahoma, NBC News projects, a victory for President Donald Trump’s preferred candidate.

headlines.title: Democratic socialists notch another win in the Oklahoma Senate primary runoff
headlines.description: Nurse N’Kiyla Jasmine Thomas has won the Democratic Senate nomination in Oklahoma, NBC News projects, defeating an older, more moderate opponent.

headlines.title: The second Dan Sullivan makes the general election in Alaska’s Senate race
headlines.description: NBC News projects that GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan and Republican Dan J. Sullivan will face off in the general election alongside former Rep. Mary Peltola, a Democrat.

headlines.title: Panda Express’ CEOs are on a ‘mission’ to help workers achieve the dream of home ownership
headlines.description: Panda Express founders Andrew and Peggy Cherng want to be known for helping their workers build careers and eventually buy their own homes.
